properties.name: font
properties.comment: The segments' and the path editor's font (Font). Throws std::invalid_argument for an invalid FontSpec; any write marks the font as set from code. A change re-lays out the segments and passes the font to the editor.
hand: shared FontCapability<BreadcrumbTrail>; prepare validates and marks the font as code's; written gives the editor the font and re-lays out

properties.name: appearance
properties.comment: Whether the segments are drawn plain or as raised arrows. An undeclared value throws std::invalid_argument; a change re-lays out the segments.
hand: prepare validates; written re-lays out and keeps the active segment

properties.name: active_id
properties.comment: The stable ID of the keyboard-active segment, the overflow or the edit button, or empty; a view, since keyboard, pointer and semantic actions move it. An ID not in the model throws std::out_of_range.
hand: a view onto active_id_, which navigation moves directly; write_view validates and keeps the active segment visible

properties.name: editing
properties.comment: Whether the exact-path editor replaces the segments. Ending an edit withdraws tab completion. begin_edit fills the editor and turns it on.
hand: written shows or hides the editor and withdraws tab completion when editing ends

properties.name: tab_completion_available
properties.comment: Whether Tab in the path editor requests completion (edit_completion_requested). It holds only while editing; a write outside an edit stores false.
hand: prepare coerces the value to false outside an edit

not_properties.name: segments
not_properties.reason: the model is replaced whole and validated as a set; stays a method beside its hidden_segment_ids projection
